messages:
sam r: Heads-up: AnthemHealth POC landed. Procurement sent a 18-question identity/security pack. Main asks: SAML EncryptedAssertion, SCIM with sub-5s change visibility (they used the phrase "near-instant"), nested groups (up to 5 levels), and fine-grained delegated admin via group->role mapping. Also want audit logs >= 12 months and KMS-backed key management. They want a short demo this week. Anyone free to confirm feasibility + pricing delta for Dedicated sandbox vs Hosted?
anya: Quick checks: EncryptedAssertion -> supported (per-tenant certs). Session timeout ask? They want browser sessions <= 15m by default and strict refresh behavior. We can enforce session TTLs on Hosted but Dedicated gives more control.
mike t: SCIM: we support SCIM v2 with delta tokens. Out of box delta token latency is ~30s for typical workloads. For sub-5s we can enable push-style webhooks + event bridge to the tenant which reduces latency to near real-time but needs extra infra (only available on Dedicated/Private). For onboarding bulk imports we recommend CSV bulk endpoint.
kelly: Nested groups: we flatten nested membership on ingest; depth isn't a hard limit but perf matters—5 levels is fine for 50k users but we need sample group graphs to tune. Group->role mapping is configurable via a mapping table; if they want delegated admin limited to specific project scopes we can do that via RBAC policies.
sam r: They also asked about SCIM rate limits during initial sync: expected burst 3k creates/min. Can we support temporary higher throughput for POC?
mike t: Default SCIM rate-limit = 1 rps per token. For Dedicated sandbox we can raise to 50 rps for the onboarding window and throttle back afterwards. We'll want to autoscale the backend for that window; ops says this is fine if we have a signed POA and IP allowlist.
security-bot: Automated note: include SOC2 report, pen-test summary, KMS integration diagram, and audit retention policy in the response pack. Link templates: http://intra.redwood/security/soc2, http://intra.redwood/security/kms-diagrams
anya: SAML specifics: we support AssertionEncryption with AES256 and RSA-OAEP wrapping. We also support EncryptedAttribute if they require attribute-level encryption. Need to confirm signing algorithms they expect (RSA-SHA256 vs. ECDSA).
kelly: Compliance ask: FedRAMP mention in questionnaire. We aren't FedRAMP certified; we can offer a FedRAMP-ready checklist and discuss Dedicated GovCloud partners / on-prem options. Legal to review export-control language.
sam r: Pricing note for the customer: propose a 6-week POC fee that covers Dedicated sandbox + elevated SCIM throughput + 1 week of on-call SE support. @kelly can you sketch numbers?
kelly: Will do. Rough sketch: Dedicated sandbox setup fee + monthly pro-rate for the weeks used. Add a temporary throughput surcharge for the onboarding window. I'll post a draft by EOD.
mike t: Action: I will draft SCIM rate-limit and bulk import docs + sample delta/webhook config. Example config snippet for webhook subscription:
```
POST /scim/v2/Subscriptions
Headers: Authorization: Bearer <token>
Body: {"events": ["User.updated","Group.updated"], "url": "https://tenant-sandbox.redwood/push"}
```
We'll include recommended retry/backoff settings.
anya: Action: I'll confirm SAML algos and session enforcement caveats (Hosted vs Dedicated).
security-bot: Reminder: include audit log retention path and KMS key lifecycle in the answers. Retention >= 12 months is supported on Dedicated; Hosted currently offers 90 days by default (can be extended as paid add-on).
sam r: Ok — I'm going to assemble the questionnaire response with these points. @mike t please cc the SCIM docs; @kelly include the pricing sketch. Demo scheduled tentatively Fri. Thanks team :thumbsup:
